201500.name: The Road To Eden

east.description: To the east lies In front of an island pier.

south.description: To the south lies The Road To Eden.

201500.description:
The road to Eden begins beneath tall trees whose branches arch overhead
and strain the sunlight to gold. Pale blossom lies in drifts on the
packed earth, and songbirds call from every bough. A track runs east
toward a silvered pier at the water's edge, while the road itself turns
south between the trunks.

201501.name: The Road To Eden

north.description: To the north lies The Road To Eden.

south.description: To the south lies The Road To Eden.

201501.description:
The road runs straight and quiet here, its ruts softened by moss and
fallen petals. Old fruit trees have seeded themselves along the verges,
and bees drone lazily in the warm air. The road climbs back north toward
the pier track and slopes on south through deepening shade.

201502.name: The Road To Eden

north.description: To the north lies The Road To Eden.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Gate To Eden.

201502.description:
The trees draw back and the road widens, and through the leaves a high
wall of pale stone gleams. A clear stream chatters through a culvert
beneath the road, and the air is sweet and utterly still. A weathered
milestone leans at the verge, its carving worn nearly smooth. The road
goes on south to the gate, and north the way you came.

201503.name: Outside The Gate To Eden

north.description: To the north lies The Road To Eden.

south.description: To the south lies Inside The Gate To Eden.

201503.description:
A tall gate of ancient wood bound in bronze fills the wall before you,
its door standing shut against the garden. Wildflowers crowd the grass
on either side, and a warm light seems to rest upon the threshold. A
faint heat shimmers in the air, smelling of cedar smoke. The road leads
back north into the trees, and beyond the door south lies the garden.

201504.name: Inside The Gate To Eden

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Gate To Eden.

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

south.description: To the south lies The Line Of Fruit Trees.

west.description: To the west lies In The Garden.

201504.description:
Inside the gate the garden opens into a wide lawn of soft grass, bright
with clover and tiny white flowers. The wall rises behind you to the
north, its stones warm as new bread. Paths of pale gravel lead east and
west, and south a row of fruit trees marches away. Light falls here gold
and heavy as honey, and a scorched ring marks the flagstones where fire
has often burned.

201505.name: In The Garden

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

south.description: To the south lies In The Garden.

west.description: To the west lies Inside The Gate To Eden.

201505.description:
A gravel path winds between beds of lavender and sage, where the air
hums with small wings. Pomegranate shrubs lean over the way, heavy with
split red fruit. West the path returns to the lawn by the gate, while
east and south it curls on deeper into the garden.

201506.name: The Line Of Fruit Trees

north.description: To the north lies Inside The Gate To Eden.

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

south.description: To the south lies The Tree Of The Knowledge Of Good And Evil.

west.description: To the west lies In The Garden.

201506.description:
Apples, plums and golden oranges grow shoulder to shoulder along this
lane, their sweetness thick on the air. Windfalls lie in the grass,
untouched and unbruised. North the lane reaches the lawn within the
gate, south it climbs to the great tree on its mound, and other ways
lead east and west into the garden.

201507.name: In The Garden

east.description: To the east lies Inside The Gate To Eden.

south.description: To the south lies In The Garden.

201507.description:
A small arbor of grapevines roofs this secluded corner, clusters of
purple fruit hanging within easy reach. Cool shade pools on the
flagstones, and a spring trickles from a mossy stone lip into a little
basin. The way east returns to the lawn by the gate, and the path south
slopes gently on.

201508.name: In The Garden

north.description: To the north lies In The Garden.

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

south.description: To the south lies In The Garden.

west.description: To the west lies The Line Of Fruit Trees.

201508.description:
Four paths meet beneath a trellis of climbing roses, their petals
scattering at the lightest breath of wind. Moss cushions the flagstones,
and a runnel of clear water slips under a tiny stone bridge. West lies a
line of fruit trees, and other paths run north, east and south.

201509.name: The Tree Of The Knowledge Of Good And Evil

north.description: To the north lies The Line Of Fruit Trees.

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

south.description: To the south lies The Line Of Fruit Trees.

west.description: To the west lies The Beehives.

201509.description:
Upon a gentle rise stands the great tree itself, vast and old, its
boughs heavy with fruit that gleams like polished jewels. The grass
about its roots is unmarked and the whole mound lies under a profound
hush. Paths lead away north and south through lines of fruit trees, east
into the garden, and west toward a distant humming of hives.

extra_descs.tree fruit boughs great tree:
The fruit hangs untouched, bright and perfect, and no bird or bee will
alight upon the boughs. A quiet gravity lies about the trunk, and even
the light seems to bow.

201510.name: In The Garden

north.description: To the north lies In The Garden.

east.description: To the east lies The Line Of Fruit Trees.

south.description: To the south lies The Beehives.

west.description: To the west lies The Flower Garden.

201510.description:
Here the garden grows wilder and sweeter, its paths half lost beneath
trailing jasmine. Wild thyme perfumes every step, and the ground rises
in soft hummocks. West the beds blaze with colour, south a low drone
rises from the hives, and east a line of fruit trees shows through the
leaves, while the path north returns toward the gate.

201511.name: In The Garden

north.description: To the north lies In The Garden.

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

south.description: To the south lies In The Garden.

west.description: To the west lies The Tree Of The Knowledge Of Good And Evil.

201511.description:
The path here is paved with smooth river pebbles that shine like coins
in the light. Tall cypresses stand about the way, and from the west a
deep hush settles over the garden, as if the very air were listening.
Ripe figs hang low from a spreading tree beside the path, and other
paths lead north, east and south.

201512.name: In The Garden

north.description: To the north lies In The Garden.

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

south.description: To the south lies In The Garden.

west.description: To the west lies The Line Of Fruit Trees.

201512.description:
A stand of date palms shades this corner, their fronds rustling like
soft whispers. Fallen dates lie sweet and sticky on the ground, and
butterflies drift between the trunks. West a line of fruit trees marches
off in an orderly row, and paths wander away north, east and south.

201513.name: In The Garden

north.description: To the north lies In The Garden.

west.description: To the west lies In The Garden.

201513.description:
The garden narrows here to a quiet nook enclosed by hedges of myrtle. A
low bench of weathered stone sits in the shade, mossy along its edges,
and the grass is thick with violets. The hedge opens only north and
west.

201514.name: In The Garden

north.description: To the north lies In The Garden.

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

west.description: To the west lies In The Garden.

201514.description:
At the far edge of the garden the wall rises thick with ivy, and the
ground is a carpet of small blue flowers. A fig tree grows out of the
wall's foot, its broad leaves shading a patch of cool earth. Paths north
and west circle back toward the lily pool, while east a narrow way
follows the wall.

201515.name: In The Garden

north.description: To the north lies The Beehives.

east.description: To the east lies The Line Of Fruit Trees.

south.description: To the south lies In The Garden.

west.description: To the west lies In The Garden.

201515.description:
A broad lawn of clover slopes down to a pool where white lilies float
upon still, green water. Reeds whisper at the edge, and the sky above is
deep and cloudless. Northward a hum of bees drifts from the hives, east
the fruit trees begin, and paths run south and west across the grass.

201516.name: In The Garden

north.description: To the north lies The Line Of Fruit Trees.

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

south.description: To the south lies In The Garden.

west.description: To the west lies In The Garden.

201516.description:
Almond trees shed pale blossom across a lawn where a stream murmurs in a
channel of white stones. The sunlight is warm and slow, and a dove's
cooing rolls down from a high branch. A line of fruit trees stands to
the north, and paths lead east, south and west.

201517.name: The Flower Garden

north.description: To the north lies The Flower Garden.

east.description: To the east lies The Beehives.

west.description: To the west lies The Flower Garden.

201517.description:
Beds of roses, lilies and anemones spill across this corner in banks of
crimson and gold. Petals carpet the paths, and the scent is almost too
rich to breathe. East the paths lead toward the hum of the hives, while
north and west they wind back among the blossoms.

201518.name: The Flower Garden

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

south.description: To the south lies The Flower Garden.

west.description: To the west lies The Flower Garden.

201518.description:
Tall delphiniums and foxgloves rise here in spires of blue and violet,
and tulips burn like lamps among the grass. A sundial of white marble
stands at the heart of the beds, its shadow slow and sure. East the path
returns to the wilder garden, while south and west it curls among the
blooms.

extra_descs.sundial marble:
The white marble is warm to the touch, and the gnomon is carved like a
single curling leaf. Around the rim runs a line of small worn letters
that speak of the unhurried hours.

201519.name: The Beehives

north.description: To the north lies In The Garden.

east.description: To the east lies The Tree Of The Knowledge Of Good And Evil.

south.description: To the south lies In The Garden.

west.description: To the west lies The Flower Garden.

201519.description:
Rows of woven straw hives stand upon stone plinths in a sunny clearing,
ringed with thyme, clover and borage. The air is thick with warm wax and
the steady hum of work, and amber honey beads in the cracks of the
straw. Paths lead north into the garden, east toward the mound of the
great tree, south to a quiet lawn, and west among the flowers.

201520.name: The Line Of Fruit Trees

north.description: To the north lies The Tree Of The Knowledge Of Good And Evil.

east.description: To the east lies In The Garden.

south.description: To the south lies In The Garden.

west.description: To the west lies In The Garden.

201520.description:
Apricot, pear and quince trees stand in a straight line here, each hung
with fruit of every season at once. The grass between the trunks is soft
as wool, and sunbeams slant down through the leaves in long bright bars.
North the line ends at a far greater tree whose shadow lies across the
path, and other ways lead east, south and west.

649400.name: songbird bird finch
649400.long_desc: A golden-breasted songbird trills from a branch, utterly unafraid.
649400.description:
A small bird with a breast the colour of new honey. It tilts its head at
you and sings as though no sorrow had ever touched the world.

649401.name: bee honeybee swarm
649401.long_desc: A drowsy honeybee hums from blossom to blossom.
649401.description:
A fat honeybee dusted with gold pollen. It is busy and gentle, and wants
nothing of you.

649402.name: deer hind doe
649402.long_desc: A dappled deer grazes calmly among the fallen blossom.
649402.description:
A slender deer with large, trusting eyes and a coat spotted like
sunlight through leaves. It lifts its head to regard you, then goes on
grazing.

649403.name: lamb white sheep
649403.long_desc: A white lamb sleeps in the grass, curled against a great lion's flank.
649403.description:
A small woolly lamb, clean and pale as new milk. It sleeps without a
care in the world.

649404.name: lion tawny great
649404.long_desc: A tawny lion lies in the sun, its heavy head resting beside a sleeping lamb.
649404.description:
A huge lion with a mane like burnished bronze. Its amber eyes follow you
with calm, regal patience, and its great paws are folded in peace.

649405.name: stag white hart
649405.long_desc: A white stag stands motionless in the shade, its antlers crowned with blossom.
649405.description:
A tall stag, white as milk, with antlers branching like a young tree in
bloom. It carries itself with a quiet nobility that few forest beasts
ever show.

649406.name: cherub guardian sword flaming
649406.long_desc: A towering cherub stands guard at the gate, a sword of living flame turning slowly in its grasp.
649406.description:
Four-faced and wreathed in light, the cherub guards the way into the
garden with a flaming sword that turns every way. It does not hunger for
battle, but none may pass it who come in malice.

749400.name: honeycomb comb honey
749400.room_desc: A piece of golden honeycomb lies here, dripping amber.
749400.description: A wedge of fresh comb, sweet and warm with the garden's sun.

749401.name: deerskin gloves soft
749401.short_desc: a pair of soft deerskin gloves
749401.room_desc: A pair of soft deerskin gloves lies here.
749401.description: Gloves of pale, supple deerskin, stitched with fine gold thread.

749402.name: amber pendant
749402.room_desc: An amber pendant glows softly here.
749402.description: A drop of clear amber on a fine chain, holding within it a little captured sunlight.

749403.name: sword flame flaming blade
749403.room_desc: A sword of pale flame burns steadily here.
749403.description: A long blade of steady, golden fire that gives off warmth and no smoke. It is bright and terrible in the hand.

749404.name: mantle hallowed white cloak
749404.room_desc: A hallowed white mantle lies folded here.
749404.description: A mantle of white wool that never gathers dust, edged with threads of gold light.
